featured_reviews.review_text:
Our visit to Sayonara Toys on 14th June  was not at all worth it. Yes, the store has a fancy collection of toys – no doubt – but that's where the positives end.

We ended up buying a few toys and were shocked with the final bill – ₹7,000 with not a single rupee in discount. In Mumbai, most toy stores happily offer at least 10–20% discount, depending on the brand. But here, when we politely asked for it, not only was the answer a flat NO, but the owner turned sarcastic and outright rude. His exact tone was dismissive, arrogant, and frankly, insulting. He even casually remarked, “We have 200% margin. So what?” –

We were literally about to walk out, but our child had already gotten attached to the toys. So, reluctantly, we went ahead and paid. That moment, we felt cheated and disrespected.

If you're looking to:

Burn a hole in your pocket 💸

Be treated with rudeness 😠

Leave with a bitter experience 👎

...then this is your place.

But if you're a sensible buyer – just go anywhere else in Mumbai. Plenty of stores offer the same products with courteous staff and genuine pricing.

We’ve personally sent messages to all friends and family never to step foot in Sayona Toys again. This was our first and definitely our last visit.
